implementation.values: Bounded 18px / opacity .75 image entry over 700ms, or 2px clarity entry over 650ms. Reconstruction estimates; source editor values unavailable. Once-entry; normal reverse scroll. No pinning.
implementation.deviation: Motion is estimated rather than exact editor reconstruction. No invented pairwise axis distinctions. Every element remains visible before script.
deleted: Legacy texture-only source backgrounds omitted where they conflicted with the locked identity; asset files retained.
No automatic decorative arrows or icon badges.

functional_checks.result: 24 browser checks clean: no overflow, required ledger omissions, missing loaded images, JS errors, or hidden reduced-motion essentials; menu/Escape functional.

motion_contract.reason: Group labels, descriptions and register action remain usable. Description first-entry opacity and later community photograph follow source reading/photo mechanisms. Closing scripture stays still.
motion_contract.reverse: Timed first-entry does not replay; declared focus recomputes on scroll and reverses. Native content remains visible.
motion_contract.mobile: No mobile pin added; same semantic order in native flow.
motion_contract.limitations: These are restrained source-mechanism adaptations, not unique arbitrary heading axes. Exact Framer editor timings unavailable.
